flags.name: httpListenAddr
flags.usage: HTTP listen address

flags.name: lakehouse.cache.disk-max-mb
flags.usage: L2 disk cache max size in MB (default: 51200)

flags.name: lakehouse.cache.disk-path
flags.usage: L2 disk cache directory path

flags.name: lakehouse.cache.memory-mb
flags.usage: L1 memory cache size in MB (default: 512)

flags.name: lakehouse.cache.memory.limit
flags.usage: Cache memory limit (Go size string, e.g. 256MB)

flags.name: lakehouse.cache.memory.request
flags.usage: Cache memory request (Go size string, e.g. 64MB)

flags.name: lakehouse.cache.memory.scaling
flags.usage: Cache memory scaling policy: fixed|linear|expbackoff

flags.name: lakehouse.cache.partition-mode
flags.usage: Cache partition mode: az-local (default), global, distributed

flags.name: lakehouse.cache.warmup-max-files
flags.usage: Max files to warm on startup; warmup runs only when this or -lakehouse.cache.warmup-partitions is set (default: 0 = 500 when warmup runs)

flags.name: lakehouse.cache.warmup-partitions
flags.usage: Number of recent hourly partitions to warm on startup; warmup runs only when this or -lakehouse.cache.warmup-max-files is set (default: 0 = 6 when warmup runs)

flags.name: lakehouse.compaction.daily-rollup-age
flags.usage: Minimum partition age for daily rollup compaction (default: 24h)

flags.name: lakehouse.compaction.enabled
flags.usage: Enable the compaction scheduler (on by default; false does not turn it off — select a profile that disables compaction in the config file)

flags.name: lakehouse.compaction.interval
flags.usage: Compaction scan interval

flags.name: lakehouse.compaction.row-group-size-by-output-level
flags.usage: Comma-separated Parquet row-group sizes per compaction output level, slot N = output level N (default: 10000,10000,20000)

flags.name: lakehouse.config
flags.usage: Path to YAML config file

flags.name: lakehouse.hot-boundary
flags.usage: Manual hot boundary override (e.g., 7d)

flags.name: lakehouse.insert.flush-interval
flags.usage: Insert flush interval (e.g., 10s)

flags.name: lakehouse.manifest.refresh-interval
flags.usage: Manifest refresh interval (e.g., 30s)

flags.name: lakehouse.pmeta.always-sketch-fields
flags.usage: Comma-separated id columns to sketch instead of enumerate (e.g. trace_id,span_id)

flags.name: lakehouse.pmeta.cardinality-threshold
flags.usage: Per-field distinct-value cap before a field is high-card (0 = default 50000)

flags.name: lakehouse.pmeta.enabled
flags.usage: Unified partition-metadata layer (catalog + file-meta + bloom facets). Disabling is a degraded mode: no metadata for new files

flags.name: lakehouse.pmeta.refuse-sketch-enumeration
flags.usage: Return empty for always-sketch field_values instead of scanning

flags.name: lakehouse.profile
flags.usage: Configuration profile: balanced, max-performance, max-durability, max-cost-savings, dev. Applied under the already-loaded config, so only keys left at zero take the profile value; prefer profile: in the config file

flags.name: lakehouse.query.file-workers
flags.usage: Number of parallel file workers for queries (default: 64)

flags.name: lakehouse.query.file-workers.limit
flags.usage: Query file-workers limit (hard ceiling)

flags.name: lakehouse.query.file-workers.request
flags.usage: Query file-workers request (always-reserved baseline)

flags.name: lakehouse.query.file-workers.scaling
flags.usage: Query file-workers scaling policy: fixed|linear|expbackoff

flags.name: lakehouse.query.max-files-per-query
flags.usage: Max S3 files per query before rejection (default: 0 = unlimited)

flags.name: lakehouse.query.max-live-bytes
flags.usage: Per-query ceiling on in-flight DataBlock bytes before cancellation (default: 512MiB)

flags.name: lakehouse.query.max-rows.limit
flags.usage: Query max-rows limit (hard ceiling)

flags.name: lakehouse.query.max-rows.request
flags.usage: Query max-rows request (operator-visible baseline)

flags.name: lakehouse.query.max-rows.scaling
flags.usage: Query max-rows scaling policy: fixed|linear|expbackoff

flags.name: lakehouse.role
flags.usage: Role: all, insert, select (default: all)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.access-key
flags.usage: S3 access key

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.bucket
flags.usage: S3 bucket name (required)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.coalesce-gap-bytes
flags.usage: Merge S3 range reads with gaps smaller than this (default: 1MB)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.concurrent-downloads.limit
flags.usage: S3 download concurrency limit (hard ceiling; default: 0 = the request, or -lakehouse.s3.max-concurrent-downloads when both are unset)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.concurrent-downloads.request
flags.usage: S3 download concurrency request (always-reserved baseline; default: 0 = limit/4 when the limit is at least 8, else the limit)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.concurrent-downloads.scaling
flags.usage: S3 download concurrency scaling policy: fixed|linear|expbackoff (empty means fixed)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.endpoint
flags.usage: Custom S3 endpoint (MinIO)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.footer-prefetch-bytes
flags.usage: Tail range-read size for parquet footer prefetch/fetch (default: 128KB logs / 640KB traces — traces L2 footers carry a 467-519KB trace index)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.force-path-style
flags.usage: Use path-style S3 URLs

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.max-concurrent-downloads
flags.usage: DEPRECATED: use -lakehouse.s3.concurrent-downloads.{request,limit,scaling}. Flat S3 download concurrency (default: 16).

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.parquet-read-mode
flags.usage: Parquet page read mode on ranged S3 opens: async (read-ahead goroutine per column) or sync (default: async)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.planned-fetch-max-inflight
flags.usage: Concurrent span GETs per file on the planned projected-read path: min(k, spans) in flight (default: 16)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.planned-fetch-span-cap-bytes
flags.usage: Per-SPAN byte cap on the planned projected-read path; coalesced spans above it are split into cap-sized concurrent GETs (CH bytes_per_read_task scope; default: 16MB)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.prefix
flags.usage: S3 key prefix

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.projected-fetch-max-bytes
flags.usage: DEPRECATED: the per-plan cap is retired (kept parsed for compatibility; plans are admitted via the memory ledger and capped per-SPAN by lakehouse.s3.planned-fetch-span-cap-bytes)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.projected-fetch-mode
flags.usage: Read strategy for column-projected parquet reads: planned (plan-then-fetch exact coalesced column-chunk ranges, no speculative window) or window (adaptive read-ahead window — rollback switch) (default: window)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.read-ahead-bytes
flags.usage: S3 read-ahead base window in bytes (default: 2MB)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.read-ahead-max-bytes
flags.usage: Adaptive read-ahead window ceiling in bytes; the window doubles from read-ahead-bytes on sequential scans (default: 8MB)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.read-ahead-waste-threshold
flags.usage: Waste-feedback threshold for the adaptive read-ahead window: when an evicted window had more than this fraction of its bytes never read, the next window halves toward read-ahead-bytes instead of growing; >=1 disables (default: 0.5)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.read-buffer-size
flags.usage: Parquet page read buffer for ranged S3 opens in bytes (default: 1MB)

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.region
flags.usage: S3 region

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.secret-key
flags.usage: S3 secret key

flags.name: lakehouse.s3.whole-file-threshold-bytes
flags.usage: S*: on the planned projected-read path, a cold-footer file below this size is downloaded whole (the download warms the footer cache) instead of footer-fetch + spans (default: 5MB logs / 8MB traces)

flags.name: lakehouse.smart-cache.disk.limit
flags.usage: Smart-cache disk limit (Go size string)

flags.name: lakehouse.smart-cache.disk.request
flags.usage: Smart-cache disk request (Go size string)

flags.name: lakehouse.smart-cache.disk.scaling
flags.usage: Smart-cache disk scaling policy: fixed|linear|expbackoff

flags.usage: Auto-register unknown X-Scope-OrgID tenants

flags.usage: S3 prefix template (default: {AccountID}/{ProjectID}/)

flags.usage: Enable the Jaeger query API (on by default; false does not turn it off)
